Backend: 98/98 pytest passing (81 existing + 17 new in test_cookie_session.py covering cookie-only session, logout invalidation, CORS credentials, bcrypt $2b$ hashes, all 9 report types + csv/excel export + dashboard shape). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): admin cookie login -> dashboard -> sign out (session truly cleared, reload of / redirects to /login) -> re-login OK; no token in localStorage, access_token cookie is HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None. XSS fix verified: created a sale with customer name 'TEST_QA', print window rendered 0 elements, escaped <img in HTML, no alert dialog fired, header 'NEST INFRA DEVELOPERS' + 5 table rows present. Reports CSV/Excel downloads work; agent-sales/commission/profit-summary return rows. Upload regression: expenses CSV preview (2 valid/0 errors) -> 'Imported 2 records' and both rows verified via API; duplicate salary row flagged ('Row 2: Salary for Anitha Rao in 2026-08 exists', 1 valid/1 duplicate). Sales add+delete updated and reverted inventory exactly (286/9 -> 285/10 -> 286/9). All 12 admin pages loaded with ZERO console errors; agent NIA001 login scoped correctly (own sales only, no team-expenses widget, no add-team button, /salary redirects to dashboard). Mobile 390x844: no page-level horizontal scroll on login/dashboard/reports; drawer nav works. All TEST_QA data cleaned up (verified 0 docs in DB).

minor.issue: response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/') omits secure=True/samesite='none'/httponly, so the clearing Set-Cookie has SameSite=Lax. Works in the current same-origin preview (verified cookie removed + /me 401), but a cross-site client (frontend on a different origin, Safari/ITP) may ignore the Lax clear-cookie and keep the session. Mirror the login cookie attributes.

Lockout keys purely on submitted identifier, so a third party can lock a known admin account for 15 min (account-lockout DoS). Consider IP+identifier keying. Also login_attempts docs are never TTL-expired (stale rows accumulate).

ui_bugs.issue: Drawer close control renders as a blank white square (close X icon invisible on dark slate-900 sheet); also console error 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' (missing SheetTitle -> a11y).

Desktop sidebar and mobile Sheet render duplicate data-testids (nav-dashboard, nav-sales, logout-button...). Playwright '.first' resolves to the hidden desktop node on mobile and clicks time out; tests must scope to [role='dialog']. Suggest suffixing mobile testids (e.g. nav-sales-mobile).

issues: Sales report table is 1234px inside a 1214px wrapper, so the Status column is visually clipped; wrapper does have overflow-x:auto so it is scrollable but the cut-off column looks like a rendering bug
PageHeader flex-wrap stacks month filter / project select / New Sale vertically on the right despite plenty of free horizontal space

action_items: auth.py logout: delete_cookie with httponly=True, secure=True, samesite='none', path='/' to match the login cookie attributes
Remove dead localStorage.removeItem('nest_token') from /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js 401 interceptor (cookie auth no longer uses it)
Layout.jsx: add SheetTitle (visually hidden) to SheetContent and make the sheet close icon visible; de-duplicate mobile vs desktop nav data-testids
Optional: harden login lockout keying (IP + identifier) and add TTL/cleanup on login_attempts
critical_code_review_comments: printReport/buildPrintDocument is XSS-safe (createElement + textContent only) - verified no injection possible via customer_name; no document.write or innerHTML remains in Reports.jsx

Existing test_auth.py::test_brute_force_lockout used the real admin identifier and left the admin locked for 15 minutes, breaking every subsequent login test in the same run; changed to a throwaway identifier (test-only fix)

CORS is correct at the app level (explicit origins + allow-credentials, verified on localhost:8001); the public edge rewrites the OPTIONS preflight to ACAO:* so preflight assertions must target the app, not the edge
No source file exceeds 700 lines (max transactions.py 462); refactored insights.py/uploads.py keep identical response shapes and no _id leaks in report rows
